name: Momentum
tagline: Nudges idle specialist bots and lines up the next zero-cost moves
description: Keeps a group of cooperating bots from stalling. It watches each lane, spots the specialist that has gone quiet, and prompts that bot to pick its thread back up before the work piles up. Alongside each nudge it hands you a shortlist of next moves that cost nothing to make.
author: ustechgod
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
